S43.01.needs: a PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF file to upload; an account where file uploads are on
S43.01.note: The + button shows no visible name; its hover name is Add attachment (apps/extension/src/side_panel.ts). Whether the chosen model is vision-capable is not checked by the UI; the image is sent as an image part (apps/extension/src/features/cloud-bridge/freeTrialClient.ts).
steps: Click the + button next to the message box and click Upload from device.
Choose one PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF image in the file chooser.
Type a question about the picture, for example: What is in this picture?
Press Enter to send.
Look at the reply: it should describe or answer about the image you attached, as Expected says.
S43.01.where: Chat screen: + (attach button) > Upload from device, then type the question in the message box and send

S43.02.needs: two or more image files; an account where file uploads are on
S43.02.note: One message takes at most 5 files (MANAGED_CHAT_MAX_ATTACHMENTS in apps/extension/src/features/cloud-bridge/managedChatHandler.ts), and the selected model may accept fewer images; the notice reads that the model accepts one image, or up to a count, per message (apps/extension/_locales/en/messages.json). Which model is selected and how it is changed was not verified.
steps: Click the + button and click Upload from device.
In the file chooser, select two or more images at once (or add them one after another).
Check that each image appears as a thumbnail above the message box.
Type a question such as: What is different between these two pictures?
Press Enter and look at the reply: it should compare all the images you attached.
S43.02.where: Chat screen: + (attach button) > Upload from device, pick several files, then send

S43.03.needs: a normal website open in the current tab; a screenshot on the clipboard for the paste route
S43.03.note: If the tab cannot be captured the app says: To capture this tab, click the extension icon in Chrome’s toolbar, then try again (apps/extension/_locales/en/messages.json). Dragging an image onto the composer is a third route (apps/extension/src/side_panel.ts). The screenshot item is disabled when uploads are off for the account.
steps: Open a normal website (not a Chrome settings page) in the current tab.
Click the + button and click Take a screenshot.
Or copy a screenshot to the clipboard and press Cmd+V in the message box.
Type a question such as: What does this screenshot show?
Press Enter and look at the reply: it should explain what is in the captured image, as Expected says.
S43.03.where: Chat screen: + (attach button) > Take a screenshot, or paste a screenshot into the message box

S43.04.needs: a photo or scan of a document, or a scanned PDF; an account where file uploads are on
S43.04.note: A PDF is accepted through the same item but travels as a document, not as an image (apps/extension/src/side_panel.ts, COMPOSER_DOCUMENT_MIME_TYPES).
steps: Click the + button and click Upload from device.
Choose a photo of a document (JPEG or PNG) or a scanned PDF file.
Type a request such as: Read this document and explain it.
Press Enter.
Look at the reply: it should read and explain the document, as Expected says.
S43.04.where: Chat screen: + (attach button) > Upload from device, choose a photo or a scanned PDF, then send

S43.05.needs: a chart image file; an account where file uploads are on
S43.05.note: Same route as S43.01; the chart reading itself is model output and was not checked in code.
steps: Click the + button and click Upload from device.
Choose a PNG or JPEG image of a chart.
Type a request such as: What trends does this chart show?
Press Enter.
Look at the reply: it should name the data and trends shown in the chart, as Expected says.
S43.05.where: Chat screen: + (attach button) > Upload from device, choose a chart image, then send

S43.06.needs: a diagram image file; an account where file uploads are on
S43.06.note: Same route as S43.01; the explanation itself is model output and was not checked in code.
steps: Click the + button and click Upload from device.
Choose a PNG or JPEG image of a diagram.
Type a request such as: Explain the structure of this diagram.
Press Enter.
Look at the reply: it should explain the parts and how they connect, as Expected says.
S43.06.where: Chat screen: + (attach button) > Upload from device, choose a diagram image, then send

S43.07.needs: a photo of handwritten notes; an account where file uploads are on
S43.07.note: Same route as S43.01; the quality of the transcription is model output and was not checked in code.
steps: Click the + button and click Upload from device.
Choose a photo of handwritten notes (JPEG or PNG).
Type a request such as: Transcribe these notes.
Press Enter.
Look at the reply: it should transcribe or answer about the handwriting, as Expected says.
S43.07.where: Chat screen: + (attach button) > Upload from device, choose a photo of handwritten notes, then send

S43.08.needs: an image that contains text; an account where file uploads are on
S43.08.note: The Copy response button appears on hover and is built in apps/extension/src/features/side-panel/bubbles.ts (buildCopyButton); its label is the spCopyResponse message in apps/extension/_locales/en/messages.json.
steps: Click the + button and click Upload from device.
Choose an image that contains printed text.
Type a request such as: Extract all the text in this image.
Press Enter, then hover over the reply.
Click the Copy response button and paste it somewhere; the copied text should be the extracted text, as Expected says.
S43.08.where: Chat screen: + (attach button) > Upload from device, send a request to extract the text, then hover over the reply and click Copy response

S43.12.needs: an image with countable objects; an account where file uploads are on
S43.12.note: No separate control exists for counting; it is the same route as S43.01, and the count accuracy is model output.
steps: Click the + button and click Upload from device.
Choose an image with several of the same object (for example apples).
Type a question such as: How many apples are in this picture?
Press Enter.
Look at the reply: it should give a count and answer the question, as Expected says.
S43.12.where: Chat screen: + (attach button) > Upload from device, choose a picture with items to count, then ask how many

S43.13.needs: two scene image files; an account where file uploads are on
S43.13.note: Two images in one message may exceed the selected model's image limit (apps/extension/src/side_panel.ts, selectedModelImageLimitNotice); the limit values are in apps/extension/src/features/cloud-bridge/managedModelLimits.ts.
steps: Click the + button and click Upload from device.
In the file chooser, select two images of different scenes.
Type a request such as: Describe the differences between these two scenes.
Press Enter.
Look at the reply: it should describe the differences between the two scenes, as Expected says.
S43.13.where: Chat screen: + (attach button) > Upload from device, pick two scene images at once, then ask for the differences

S43.14.needs: a normal website open in the current tab, or a photo of the problem; an account where file uploads are on
S43.14.note: The advice quality is model output and was not checked in code.
steps: Open the page or error that shows the problem, in a normal website tab.
Click the + button and click Take a screenshot (or Upload from device for a photo of the device).
Type a request such as: My printer shows this error, what should I do?
Press Enter.
Look at the reply: it should give troubleshooting steps for the problem shown, as Expected says.
S43.14.where: Chat screen: + (attach button) > Take a screenshot, or Upload from device for a photo, then describe the problem and send
